concerns.text: FR-005 – Outcome Variable Definition has no corresponding task; no task verifies that each dataset’s outcome column is documented and recorded in `data/processed/dataset_metadata.json`.

FR-006 – Assumption Checks & Robust Fallback lack a dedicated task; while outlier‑sweep tasks exist, there is no task that runs Shapiro‑Wilk, Levene, linearity checks and records `assumptions_met` flags.
FR-007 – Multiple‑Comparison Holm‑Bonferroni correction is not linked to any task; no task verifies adjusted p‑values or asserts FWER ≤ 0.05.
FR-008 – Sensitivity Analysis is absent from the task list; no task runs the factorial size‑/missingness‑bin analysis or validates `sensitivity_metrics.json`.
FR-009 – Dataset schema validation has no associated task; no task invokes validation against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`.
FR-010 – Baseline metrics schema validation is missing; no task checks `baseline_metrics.json` against its contract.
FR-011 – Cleaned metrics schema validation is missing; no task validates `cleaned_metrics.json` against its schema.
FR-013 – Cleaning‑metadata schema validation is not covered by any task.
FR-015 – Bin‑coverage dataset acquisition logic has no task; the pipeline does not ensure each size/missingness bin contains at least one dataset.
FR-016 – A priori power analysis is absent; no task performs the Wilcoxon‑based power analysis and records justification.
FR-017 – Generation and validation of `dataset_metadata.json` is not linked to any task.
FR-019 – Principle II citation‑validation step has no task; the required script is never executed.
FR-020 – External benchmark simulation (synthetic null and non‑null datasets) lacks a task.
FR-021 – Hypothesis‑testing on Δ‑metrics (Wilcoxon on `p_value_delta`) is not represented by any task.
SC-005 – Outcome variable verification is missing; no task ensures `dataset_metadata.json` records a verified numeric outcome column.
SC-006 – Assumption‑check flagging and robust fallback recording are not covered by any task.
SC-007 – Verification that Holm‑Bonferroni adjusted p‑values satisfy FWER ≤ 0.05 is absent.
SC-008 – Validation that each size‑ and missingness‑bin contains ≥ 1 dataset is missing.
SC-009 – Comprehensive contract‑validation step for all artefacts is not present as a task.
SC-010 – No task records or checks the power‑analysis justification required by the success criterion.
SC-011 – No task verifies that the Wilcoxon test on `p_value_delta` yields a statistically significant result (p < 0.05).
SC-012 – No task validates external benchmark results (FPR ≤ 0.05, effect‑size tolerance ± 0.1).
Phase 5 (Permutation‑Based FPR) lacks a task that ensures permutation occurs **before** cleaning as required by FR‑006; existing tasks T039a/b perform permutation after cleaning, violating the spec.
Phase 6 (Multiple‑Comparison Correction) does not reference a specific JSON field or schema for adjusted p‑values, and no task validates the correction against FR‑007.
